baseline_decision.sentence: Curator view (whole vault, all depositors): EXIT means pulling the vault's money out of its markets, STAY means keeping the allocation. STAY — exiting (only 28% can be exited now) would avoid $1,180 of expected loss over the horizon, but would cost $47,276. ($1,979 of expected loss cannot be avoided by exiting: it stays with the asset you get back.) Exit if you put the risk "PST collateral drop" above 4.4% (our estimate: 0.10%, i.e. ≈ once every 20 years).
